annotations.title: ENS: resolve a name to an address, or an address to its primary name (verified)

description: ENS: resolve a name to an address, or an address to its primary name (verified). Give "name" (vitalik.eth) to get its Ethereum address, resolver and namehash; give "address" to get its primary ENS name via reverse resolution, verified by resolving the name forward again. Reads the ENS registry on Ethereum mainnet. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
